sample_unit: operating room healthcare professionals (nurses, OR technicians, anesthesiology personnel)

links.outcome: AI knowledge and perception scores among operating room staff
links.effect: Mean knowledge score 2.11 ± 0.76 out of 7 (30.1% of maximum); perception mean 76.8 ± 14.5 out of 125; knowledge and perception moderately correlated (r = 0.421).
links.quote: Participants demonstrated limited AI knowledge (mean score: 2.11 ± 0.76 out of 7; 30.1% of the maximum possible score), whereas perceptions toward AI were generally positive (mean score: 76.8 ± 14.5 out of 125).

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey evaluating knowledge and perceptions of AI among operating room staff; does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
